articles.title: FAA lifts nationwide ground stop that blocked takeoffs for hours
articles.description: Takeoffs from airports throughout the US largely stopped on Friday after the FAA issued a national ground stop at 3:44PM ET "due to extraordinary circumstances and for reasons of safety."
